title: DNA extraction for vertebrate tissues
author: Chang Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssyeefw

steps.title: Collect and prepare tissue
steps.instruction: Collect muscle tissue from spotted sea bass, defrost, wash briefly with normal saline (Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co.), and cut approximately 0.5 g of tissue.

steps.title: Lyse tissue with buffer
steps.instruction: Add STE buffer, SDS to a final concentration of 10 % (Ambion), and protease K to 20 mg ml⁻¹ (New England Biolabs) to the tissue, mix, then incubate for 4–6 h at 56 °C while shaking at 500 rpm.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol : chloroform : isoamylol (25 : 24 : 1, Sinopharm) to the lysate, invert gently for 3–5 min at room temperature, centrifuge at 13 600 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C, and transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform : isoamylol (24 : 1, Sinopharm) to the transferred supernatant, invert gently for 3–5 min at room temperature, centrifuge at 13 600 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C, and transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol (Sinopharm) to the aqueous phase, mix by slow inversion, incubate the tube at –20 °C overnight, then centrifuge at 13 600 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 70 % ethanol (Sinopharm) to the pellet, flick the tube to resuspend and wash for 3–5 min; centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C and discard ethanol. Add another 1 ml of 70 % ethanol, mix gently, centrifuge again at 13 000 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C and discard ethanol. Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 30 s, discard the liquid, and air‑dry the pellet for 5–10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: RNase treatment and resuspension
steps.instruction: Add RNase (FERMENTAS Inc.) and 100 µl TE buffer (Invitrogen‑Thermo Fisher) at a TE:RNase ratio of 100:1, then incubate at 37 °C for 30 min in a thermomixer to dissolve the DNA pellet.
